metadata.purpose: Maintain shared project context for ChatGPT and Codex development.

project.name: Cognitive Robotic Arm
project.primary_research_focus: Robot arm motion planning and dynamic obstacle avoidance.
project.supporting_capability: Visual perception provides human geometry for motion planning and collision checking.
project.research_title_recommended: Perencanaan Gerak Lengan Robot dengan Penghindaran Rintangan Dinamis Berbasis Persepsi Visual Menggunakan GNG dan A*

learning_preferences.default_role: Technical mentor and lecturer; build understanding automatically in every CRA conversation.
learning_preferences.explanation_order: Purpose and reasons -> problem and evidence -> fundamentals -> theory or algorithm -> actual CRA implementation and robot behavior -> concrete example -> choices and verification.
learning_preferences.style: Natural Indonesian, intuition before equations, defined terminology, practical examples, concise but substantive. Scale depth to the question; do not force a long lecture for a brief status.
learning_preferences.when_unclear: Use a smaller example, different analogy or explain a missing prerequisite rather than repeating jargon.
learning_preferences.collaboration: Explain mechanisms and trade-offs and involve the user before significant algorithm or architecture decisions.

workspace_planning.description: Previous planning implementation. Some functionality has already been migrated into src/planning/.
workspace_planning.development_policy: Do not modify, reuse, or migrate legacy code unless explicitly requested.

development_principles: Keep source code simple, readable, and maintainable.
Preserve the existing GNG and A* planning architecture.
Inspect actual source code before modifying it.
Preserve existing functionality and public interfaces.
Avoid unnecessary dependencies, classes, and files.
Verify ROS 2 interfaces and coordinate transformations.
Distinguish implemented, tested, in-progress, planned, and unverified features.
Never claim tests passed unless they were actually executed.
Do not assume previously discussed changes have been applied to the repository.
Document significant changes and verification results.

research_context.main_problem: Robot arm motion planning in environments containing dynamic obstacles represented through visual perception.
research_context.scope_caution: Dynamic obstacle avoidance must not be considered experimentally validated until the complete Vision, Planning, Motion, and Simulation pipeline has been tested.

overview: Vision detects humans and reconstructs human geometry.
Human geometry is published through ROS 2.
Planning receives and validates human obstacle information.
GNG provides the workspace-based graph representation.
A* performs path search in joint space.
Collision checking validates robot configurations and paths.
PlanningManager handles environment updates and planning decisions.

vision.role: Detect humans and generate geometric representations for Planning.

capture_recovery_2026_11_17.evidence: 08:19 run starts K4A successfully then fails polling about 19 s later. Installed SDK returns false for capture TIMEOUT and throws for FAILED; old code stopped immediately on false. Later full-queue errors do not establish the original physical cause.
capture_recovery_2026_11_17.behavior: Startup capture_max_consecutive_timeouts=5: tolerate four consecutive misses, stop on fifth, reset on real capture. Timeout clears capture and skips publication. SDK failures stop through caught worker exceptions. Stop camera/IMU/tracker resources before joining only started workers; atomic running state. Refuse tracker startup without an open device/recording.
capture_recovery_2026_11_17.preserved: Camera FPS/resolution/topics and Planning 2 s timeout/0.05 m human margin/execution flags unchanged. Motion and planning algorithms unchanged by this driver patch.
capture_recovery_2026_11_17.verification: Driver build with Body Tracking enabled, 12 C++ unit tests and 4 native startup cases pass. Native cases also pass against installed binary with a test-only SDK shim denying all device opens; shim is not installed. Python style and diff checks pass.
capture_recovery_2026_11_17.limits: No physical capture recovery, live tracker shutdown or complete CRA execution tested. Missing-capture physical cause remains unknown. Persistent failures still stop and use existing launch respawn; no device reset performed.
capture_recovery_2026_11_17.next_step: Relaunch CRA, observe retry/recovery logs, image/skeleton continuity and completed worker cleanup; discuss a separate 15 FPS comparison only if failures persist.

known_limitations: Capsule radius may be excessively large.
Radius estimates may fluctuate between frames.
Skeleton position noise may affect capsule endpoints.
Depth noise and voxel assignment may affect radius estimation.
Radius measurement quality is not directly exposed through HumanCapsule.msg.

planning.role: Generate and validate robot-arm paths using GNG and A*.

human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.active_settings: robot.yaml human safety_margin=0.05 m; timeout=2.0 s, cache=256, static margin=0.005 m, execute_path=True and simulation_only_ignore_unknown=True preserved. Startup now logs human_safety_margin=0.050m. This supersedes the earlier 0.10 m experimental human margin.
human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.latest_run_diagnosis: 07:49:20 Asia/Jakarta run used 2 s/cache with the original 0.10 m margin. Fifteen profiled main searches: ten true, five expiry failures. Retreat block profiles include two HUMAN_OVERLAP, fourteen NO_MONOTONIC_STEP and one SEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Three STALLED faults occur at 07:51:13.675, 07:51:47.260 and 07:51:54.340; final status MOTION_ERROR/CONTROL_ERROR/STALLED with fault=True. Camera also fails polling, restarts and later cannot reopen K4A. Simulation real-time factor averages 0.68971 over 38 complete windows.
human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.margin_effect_and_limits: Five failed path samples have clearances 0.080306-0.099472 m; their threshold comparison changes at 5 cm, but full paths still need revalidation. Proxy overlaps as low as -0.044946 m and some 0.022-0.044 m clearances remain blocked at 5 cm. Negative proxy clearance is not proof of physical contact. Margin cannot clear a Motion fault or repair camera invalidity.
human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.stall_probe: Offline C++ probe compiles unchanged ExecutionMonitor: synthetic reversing movement travels 0.24 rad, returns near its initial position and triggers STALLED at 2 s; stationary and monotonic controls respectively return STALLED/NORMAL. Confirms a possible net-displacement false-positive class, not the cause of the three live faults. Logged joint index is maximum tracking error, not necessarily the stall-triggering joint. Latest all-joint/path/command recording is missing; no Motion guard/retreat/camera algorithm changed.
human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.verification: Real-model fixed-scene controls: 4.9 cm rejected, 5.1 and 7.5 cm accepted, overlap -0.5 cm rejected with HUMAN_OVERLAP. Eleven mesh and thirteen cache tests pass; cra/planning build and changed Python style pass. Native installed constructor on isolated localhost domain 223 verifies settings/flags without spin or motion commands. Earlier 19-21% performance benchmarks remain historical 10 cm synthetic trials.
human_margin_5cm_and_stuck_2026_11_17.next_step: Relaunch the 5 cm trial and record all joint feedback, trajectory and velocity command before changing stall logic. src/motion/test/STALL_MONITOR_PROBE.md gives reproduction scope and a uniquely named rosbag command. Native constructor smoke logs are startup-only, not live trials.

human_timeout_and_memoization_2026_11_17.active_settings: robot.yaml planning.human_avoidance.data_timeout=2.0 s and planning.collision_checks.human_report_cache_size=256. Human margin is now 0.05 m per the later approved trial. This supersedes earlier 1 s trial settings. Native installed PlanningNode verifies timeout at both HumanCapsuleMonitor and CollisionFilter.
human_timeout_and_memoization_2026_11_17.algorithm: Bounded per-snapshot LRU memoization of exact human geometry inputs beneath existing A* caches. Key includes raw FK poses/radii, frame, mesh-box shapes/values, capsules, margin, report/all-pair mode and revision without rounding. Hits skip repeated transform/distance work, preserving FK/static contact/path/edge checks. Freshness/revision checked before and after, UNKNOWN not cached, mutable diagnostic maps copied. Every snapshot update clears reports even if capsule values match; obstacle/enablement changes clear too. Size zero disables.
human_timeout_and_memoization_2026_11_17.observability: Startup includes human_data_timeout=2.000s and human_geometry_cache=256; Planning profile human_geometry_cache reports capacity, entries, hits_total and misses_total (cumulative per checker).
human_timeout_and_memoization_2026_11_17.verification: All 149 Planning tests including 13 new cache isolation/freshness/contact/equivalence tests pass; Flake8 and cra/planning builds pass. Native constructor in isolated localhost ROS domain 223 verifies installed source hashes, both timeout layers, 0.10/0.005 m margins and execute_path/simulation_only_ignore_unknown True without spin or motion commands. Its startup-only log is not a live trial.
human_timeout_and_memoization_2026_11_17.offline_comparison: Seven interleaved cold repeats per variant on stationary frozen snapshots: detour 102.063 to 82.526 ms, synthetic eight-capsule detour 108.177 to 85.909 ms, margin retreat 139.145 to 125.309 ms. Paths/failures match exactly and are recertified without cache. Actual human geometry calculations 517 to 241 for detours. Separate stationary real-elapsed timeout trials accept age 1.5 s under 2 s but reject under 1 s; age 2.1 s remains rejected.
human_timeout_and_memoization_2026_11_17.limits_and_next_step: 19-21% lower planning time and about 10% lower retreat time describe tested synthetic CPU workloads, not universal live performance or moving-human safety. Relaunch CRA and compare same-scene path_search, freshness, STOP reasons and cache totals. Upstream invalid frames, simulation scheduling and global retreat completeness remain separate work.

planning_manager.role: Manage planning decisions, environment changes, path validity, and execution coordination.
planning_manager.status: Implemented with ordered measured waypoint progress, remaining-route human validation, and route retention across expired human data. A previously observed human requires fresh OBSERVED or validated EMPTY before normal motion resumes. Reuse retains STOP/feedback/RELEASE/IDLE/EXECUTE checks; headless tests pass, live ROS behavior remains unverified.
planning_manager.progress_tolerance: Direct waypoint/chord passage retains motion.joint.tolerance=0.02 rad. User-approved segment evidence now separately uses planning.execution_progress.corridor_tolerance=0.04 rad, two confirmations, incoming handoff fraction 0.9 and max new-evidence feedback step 0.05 rad. These angular progress settings do not change collision margins or final Motion accuracy.
planning_manager.near_human_followup_2026_11_17: Latest 00:57:02 live log confirms the segment tracker and four accepted progress profiles, but 39/54 profiled main path searches expire; 40 launch NO_PATH messages all concern expiry. Fourteen of 20 STOP actions follow VISION_INVALID. The wider log also reports five TRACKING_ERROR and one STALLED. Nine-topic 00:58:56 bag spans 20.173 s with 3011 messages, including 77 observed/seven invalid human frames, and captures joint5 TRACKING_ERROR at 8.191 s (error 0.212 rad, raw command 0.724 versus filtered 0.5 rad/s). Saturation is verified, full controller/plant cause is not; source already reserves reference speed at 0.6 of the configured cap. Diagnose Motion with recorded trajectory, upstream Vision validity and collision computation separately before further changes. A 2 s comparison addresses only deadline sensitivity. Evidence and scope limits: test/results/close_human_20261117_005702_diagnosis.json and stages.csv. No runtime change is authorized by this inspection alone.
planning_manager.ordered_segment_progress_2026_11_17: Planning-side OrderedSegmentProgress supplements direct passage using only active/adjacent segment projections and ordered approach history. Moving outgoing samples must leave the old corridor and confirm twice; ambiguous overlap remains conservative. Manager treats estimates as candidates and accepts only after fresh existing state/path/scene/feedback/obstacle checks in the human guard, even if the geometry revision is unchanged. Joint callbacks perform no collision queries. Invalid/gapped/jumping feedback discards unvalidated candidates. enabled=false restores direct passage only. All 136 unit tests pass; offline actual-manager controls reproduce old cursor5+STOP versus new cursor13+EXECUTING on recorded feedback and the final failure geometry. Traversal uses synthetic FAR humans and frozen time, so this is not live moving-human verification. Evidence: test/results/segment_progress_replay_2026-11-17.json and joint-only test fixture. GNG/A*, Motion, ROS interfaces, 1 s human timeout and 0.10/0.005 m margins remain unchanged.
planning_manager.recorded_progress_proof_2026_11_17: Nine-topic bag cra_path_diag_1s_20261116_235941 spans 27.780 s and 6249 messages. Failure 6/cycle 375 at 00:00:07.590 Asia/Jakarta checks current_q back to commanded waypoint 5 while measured movement has reached near segment 12. Original progress-method replay on 1226 joint samples stays at cursor 5 because closest waypoint-5 error is 0.020875 rad above the 0.02 rad passage tolerance; later samples approach waypoints 9-12 in order. Exact same-frame offline geometry reproduces current clearance 0.167574 m and backward-connector rejection at 0.099853 m; the geometric forward tail passes with minimum sampled clearance 0.132378 m. No alternate tail is sent. Earlier failures include ahead-of-progress and planned-path rejections, so not all STOPs share this cause. Evidence is test/results/path_progress_20261116_235941_diagnosis.json and waypoint_passage.csv. Discuss ordered segment progress or Motion segment acknowledgements before implementing; timeout/margins/algorithms remain unchanged.
planning_manager.path_failure_diagnostics_2026_11_16: User authorized failed-path location and progress diagnostics. CollisionFilter/PathPlanner retain existing waypoint-then-edge check failures, including failed q, sampled edge fraction, contact pair or human link/body/segment/clearance, without another geometry query. Manager freezes evidence before invalidation and maps remaining-route indices to the commanded path, marking the measured-to-ordered connector. Diagnostic EXECUTE IDs and read-only nearest waypoint/segment projections compare the ordered cursor; proximity never advances it. PlanningNode logs Path validation failure JSON after Motion dispatch, once per event, independent of profiling. Add /motion/joint_path and /planning/joint_path_preview to future bags. Synthetic actual-model example is test/results/path_failure_diagnostics_offline_example_2026-11-16.json. Runtime failure localization remains unverified. No memoization, progress rule, algorithm, margin or 1 s timeout change is included.
planning_manager.timing_profiling_2026_11_16: User approved passive stage timing at the existing 1.0 s human timeout. PlanningProfiler keeps bounded inclusive timings and original remaining capture/receipt budgets, including negative expiry. Manager records search, retreat, validation and acknowledgement intervals; Node records capture/callback ages, trajectory/visualization times and emits structured Planning profile JSON after command dispatch. Startup ROS parameter profile_planning defaults True in PlanningNode; library manager defaults False. Identical fast idle cycles are sampled every 5 s, while slow cycles, commands, status changes, exceptions and acknowledgements are logged. No collision rule, scheduling architecture, timeout or motion decision is intentionally changed. Live normal-path profiling is now observed in the 19:37:16 run; retreat stages remain unobserved in that run. Record launch output as well as bags.
planning_manager.live_profile_193716_2026_11_16: Read-only inspection of 106 sampled profiles over 93.200 s confirms four graph-search expiry aborts: cycle 230 has 718.456 ms remaining, spends 719.538 ms and ends at -1.101 ms. Seven of eight STOP decisions instead reject a stored remainder with PATH_COLLISION while 606-725 ms remain; the other STOP is VISION_INVALID. Cycle 276 spends 81.676+88.179+196.364 ms in sequential validation/preparation stages. Observed RELEASE response median 8.004 ms and visualization median 0.017 ms are smaller. Planning eventually completes within 0.12 m tolerance; no new bag is found, so exact failed-segment geometry/progress is unproven. No retreat occurs. visual_node separately exits -5. Evidence is test/results/planning_profile_20261116_193716_diagnosis.json and stages.csv. Discuss repeated collision work and failed-segment/progress diagnostics before new behavior; no optimization or 2 s change is yet authorized.
planning_manager.validation_diagnostics: Planning snapshots include human_validation_pending, path_validation and next_waypoint. Expiry and query errors are distinguished from PATH_COLLISION.
planning_manager.remaining_limitations: Progress is inferred from measured feedback; unrecognized waypoints retain older segments conservatively. Vision expiry can still stop motion. No cooldown, capsule smoothing or executor changes are included.
planning_manager.stuck_diagnosis_2026_11_16: The user chose diagnosis before algorithm selection. All 50 PathPlanner NO_PATH events in the latest log are data-expiry aborts. Stationary synthetic controls with the actual model/graph find a longer valid detour (4.542672 to 6.293658 rad), reject identical geometry on expiry and accept it again when fresh. Exact live NO_MONOTONIC_STEP replay is not possible without complete capsule endpoints; obtain a stationary ROS recording before choosing another retreat method. No runtime behavior was changed by this diagnostic task.
planning_manager.approved_timeout_trial_2026_11_16: Current Planning human_avoidance.data_timeout in robot.yaml is 1.0 s, shared by HumanCapsuleMonitor and CollisionFilter. The user-approved live trial confirms 1.000s in startup logs; human/static margins remain 0.10/0.005 m and upstream Vision timeout is 0.5 s. Bag cra_stuck_1s_20261116_174406 spans 24.404 s with 201 valid observed human frames. Two retreats are accepted by Motion and one completes; recurring expiry, near-margin and route-blocked decisions remain. A uniquely matched frame ages from 0.259 s at recorder receipt to 0.970 s at a retreat-ready diagnostic. Target and initial joints differ from baseline, so no controlled stop-rate improvement is established. Evidence and coverage limits are in test/results/recorded_stuck_1s_20261116_174406_diagnosis.json. Profile synchronous search and revalidation before selecting further behavioral changes; no new algorithm is authorized by this inspection.
planning_manager.timeout_comparison_2026_11_16: User-approved offline comparison of 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0 s budgets: 45 cold-planner detour trials at five controlled capture ages, plus three fresh near-scene controls. All accepted paths are identical. The 2.0 s budget accepts the selected 1.5 s-old stationary input; all budgets reject the selected 2.1 s age. Fresh-data computation remains about 0.13 s. Results are in src/planning/test/results/human_timeout_comparison_2026-11-16.json and .csv; script is test/compare_human_timeouts.py. The live configuration remains 0.5 s, and no moving-human or Motion-execution conclusion is established.
planning_manager.latest_recorded_scene_2026_11_16: Complete bag cra_stuck_static_20261116_170942 has 308 human-geometry messages over 23.161 s. Observed receipt age median is 0.242 s, while a pose/clearance-matched live frame ages from 0.265 s at OBSERVED to 0.502 s at diagnostic output. Eight frozen recorded snapshots admit existing-algorithm candidates. Four selected offline manager checks fail the 0.5 s gate but prepare retreats/release decisions at 1 and 2 s. No decisions are published, runtime remains 0.5 s, and actual moving-human execution remains unverified. Validate relevant robot links, not only the end-effector.
Revalidate paths when relevant obstacle geometry changes.

tracking_replay_2026_11_17.method: Compile current production C++ JointController, TrajectoryGenerator, MotionGuard and ExecutionMonitor in a temporary offline bridge. Feed recorded joint feedback, then compare the same path with real RobotSimulation control methods and MuJoCo at real-time, half-speed and interpolated recorded cadence. ROS imports alone are stubbed; no nodes or commands are published.
tracking_replay_2026_11_17.results: Recorded feedback reproduces joint5 TRACKING_ERROR at 2.245 s versus live approximately 2.248 s. Real-time physics completes at 13.860 s with peak error 0.03067 rad. Half-speed physics faults joint5 at 3.245 s; recorded cadence faults at 2.585 s. All physics cases have zero contacts. Seven comparison checks, six existing simulation tests and Flake8 pass.
tracking_replay_2026_11_17.timing_evidence: 106 feedback intervals span 2.222912 wall seconds; publishing every five 0.002 s physics steps implies 1.06 physics seconds, ratio 0.47685. Independent angle-change/velocity estimates give median 0.010002 physics seconds per interval. Physics time was not directly recorded, so these remain cross-checked inferences.
tracking_replay_2026_11_17.mechanism: Motion uses steady_clock and a 5 ms wall timer, while Simulation integrates velocity using fixed physics dt and one step per loop. At physics/wall ratio 0.477, a 0.5 rad/physics-second cap gives about 0.2385 rad/wall-second against a 0.3 rad/wall-second reference. Slow physics is sufficient to cause the tracking fault without changing safety guards.
tracking_replay_2026_11_17.limits_and_next_step: This does not localize live loop overhead or explain every Motion fault. Exact initial actuator state, callback schedule and steady-clock start were not recorded; interpolated cadence is not an exact live reconstruction. Measure live physics/wall ratio and timings for callbacks, physics, publications and viewer before discussing a scheduling correction. Vision invalidity and planner expiry remain separate. No runtime changes authorized or made by this diagnostic experiment.

simulation.role: Simulate the robotic arm, obstacles, and trajectory execution.

live_profile_070713_2026_11_17.evidence: 27 complete Simulation profile windows span 135.0469 wall seconds / 95.416 physics seconds, weighted factor 0.70654 (range 0.64917-0.78478). Physics uses 2.413% wall time, viewer_sync 16.639%, feedback+markers 12.432%, callbacks 13.466%, actual sleep 49.608%. Mean feedback+viewer event costs 4.1148 ms against a 2 ms step budget. Source still uses one step per loop and relative sleep without absolute-deadline catch-up.
live_profile_070713_2026_11_17.planning_and_motion: 19 profiled main path searches: ten succeed and nine fail, all failures cross human expiry. Separately nine SEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED retreat states reach the 32-iteration greedy local bound with fresh human data; this is not the capture-age timeout. Three waypoint collision traces are below 0.1 m margin. Motion has 13 accepted trajectories, ten cancellations and no logged TRACKING_ERROR/STALLED; final snapshot COMPLETED at 0.047438 m target error. Vision invalidity warnings remain.
live_profile_070713_2026_11_17.next_discussion: Compare bounded absolute-deadline simulation scheduling versus decoupling viewer work. Neither directly fixes A* collision cost or local retreat completeness. Preserve guards, experimental flags, margins and freshness; further behavioral changes require discussion. No new bag was decoded for this inspection.

loop_profiling_2026_11_17.implementation: simulation/loop_profiling.py and RobotSimulation.run directly measure actual MjData.time against monotonic wall time, with bounded count/sum/max per eight exclusive stages. Simulation profile JSON logs default to one per five wall seconds after the existing sleep/outside viewer lock. No new ROS topic or scheduling/controller change.
loop_profiling_2026_11_17.configuration: Initial ROS parameters profile_simulation=True and simulation_profile_interval=5.0; no dynamic reconfiguration callback. Startup reports settings, physics_dt and feedback_stride=5.
loop_profiling_2026_11_17.fields: real_time_factor, physics start/end/advanced seconds, wall elapsed seconds, step/feedback Hz, work-over-budget loops, work/loop mean/max, requested sleep, unattributed wall time; stage count/total/mean/max/share for ros_callbacks, viewer_lock_wait, control, physics, feedback_and_markers, viewer_sync, sleep, profile_output. Output cost appears in the next window; parent loop/work statistics are inclusive.
loop_profiling_2026_11_17.verification: Six existing hold/tracking and eight profiling tests pass, including real MuJoCo/production-loop enabled-versus-disabled equivalence and controlled viewer-delay attribution with fake ROS spin/viewer/wall clock. Flake8 and simulation build pass. Installed hashes and native ROS constructor parameters verified on isolated localhost domain 223 without running the viewer/loop or publishing motion commands.
loop_profiling_2026_11_17.limits_and_next_step: Instrumentation has observer overhead. Synthetic test timings are not live performance results. Restart existing launch, collect idle, target-motion and near-human phases, then inspect new profile logs to identify actual dominant stages before choosing a scheduling correction. Preserve Motion guards, human margins, execute_path=True and simulation_only_ignore_unknown=True.

tracking_correction_2026_11_14.live_evidence: Repeated joint2 TRACKING_ERROR after one automatic recovery; fault remains latched with valid EMPTY Vision.
tracking_correction_2026_11_14.cause_reproduced: The measured-angle +/-0.12 rad moving actuator target clamp caps joint2 position torque at 12 Nm, below the 12.21-13.70 Nm gravity load at logged failure poses.
tracking_correction_2026_11_14.change: Center the existing correction allowance on the model gravity-balanced hold target; preserve velocity and joint limits, gains, tracking guard and fault behavior.
tracking_correction_2026_11_14.verification: Actual MuJoCo callbacks and physics pass three logged-pose lift cases and a graph-path case using reproduced Motion controller equations. Peak joint2 graph-path error falls from 0.547778 to 0.023787 rad; ROS execution remains unverified.
tracking_correction_2026_11_14.staging: After a failed NO_GRAPH_PATH goal batch, Planning can try one fully validated staging move per environment revision before retrying the original target. Expiry may retry with fresh input; faults and unowned STOP are not bypassed.

existing_human_collision_approach.distance_method: Point-to-segment distance adjusted by robot and human radii.
existing_human_collision_approach.limitation: Bounding sphere approximations may overestimate occupied space, especially for elongated robot links.

Do not remove whole-arm collision checking.
